title: MZ GALV Camera Control + Tile Priority are causing jittering effect

posts.author: Jenai
posts.body:
Hi there!
In my game project, I am using sprites that are twice the size of normal RMMZ sprites. This causes some annoying clipping effects, e.g. when a character stands in front of a *-tile. To get around this problem, I use a so-called 'tile priority' or 'y-sort' plugin. The one I use is "Cyclone-TilePriority" by Hudell. Unfortunately it does not work properly once a map is large enough to scroll. There is a very annoying jittering effect.  Working with only screen-sized maps is too restrictive. So this is out of the question.
Maybe some aspect of the cross engine is the reason for this. Perhaps the cross-engine version of Altimit movement. Using hudells tile priority plugin along with altimit on a fresh MV game project on a large map does not cause this jittering effect.
I was wondering if there was a known fix for this problem. Or maybe even a better working plugin for the Chrono/Cross engine that i dont know of.
I really hope someone can help me with this problem as the player experience will suffer from this jittering effect as you can imagine.
Looking forward to your solutions/ideas

Hi Aqua! I have tried this plugin but there is no change to the problem.... at least I thought so. Turns out the problem is Galv's CamControl plugin. With this turned off, the plugin you linked works fine (Restarts jitter fix for cross engine also works fine).
I will be looking for a similar smooth camera plugin that does not conflict with either the cross-engine or tile priority plugin or any of the jitter fix plugins.
I am already a tiny bit smarter than i was before, thanks to you guys!
E: So far i tested 3 more smooth camera plugins (Keke's Free Camera, Dragon's Dragon Smooth Camera and Ignis Smooth Camera Slide). The problem occurs with all three of them.
